test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A group of stars which form a pattern and have a name
solution:
The correct answer is: **Constellation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Constellation** means a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern that is traditionally named after its apparent form or identified with a mythological figure.

 
 
• **Example -** *The **constellation** Ursa Major contains the stars of the Big Dipper.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the **'Constellation'** can be used as a one-word substitute for **'A group of stars which form a pattern and have a name.'**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Configuration** means an arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination.
 
• **Contortion** means the skill of twisting and bending one's body into strange and unnatural positions, as a form of entertainment.
 
• **Condemnation** means criticizing something or someone strongly, usually for moral reasons.
